journey.title: Dismiss suggestions with Escape while editing a saved city
journey.goal: Escape closes the suggestion list and keeps the city the user typed

functionalJourney.title: Pick a suggested city with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Typing part of a name and clicking a suggestion saves that city

guards.title: ArrowDown and Enter still select a suggestion
guards.goal: Typing Fa, ArrowDown and Enter saves Faro

attempts.failure: Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 1115 (line 10 column 5)

plan.root_cause: The autoComplete library's default keydown handler for the Escape key clears the input value when dismissing the suggestion list, instead of preserving the user's typed input.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a custom keydown event handler in the autoComplete configuration that intercepts the Escape key, prevents the default behavior (which clears the input), and programmatically closes the suggestion list while preserving the input value.

edits.before: events: { input: { selection: event => { window.cityPicker.input.value = event.detail.selection.value; } } }

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Escape while editing a city will dismiss the autocomplete suggestions without losing the user's typed input, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order) by ensuring keyboard dismissal works predictably.
functional_risks: If the library's event system replaces rather than chains keydown handlers, arrow key navigation may break (mitigated by only handling Escape and not calling preventDefault for other keys)
The close() method may not exist on the instance (guarded with typeof check)
verification_requirements: ArrowDown and Enter still select suggestions
Form submission saves the typed city

plan.root_cause: The autoComplete library's default keydown handler for the Escape key clears the input value when dismissing the suggestion list, instead of preserving the user's typed input. Adding a custom keydown handler via events.config replaces the library's default keydown handler, breaking arrow key navigation (ArrowDown/Enter selection).
plan.repair_strategy: Add a separate keydown event listener directly on the input element after initialization to intercept the Escape key, prevent the default behavior (which clears the input), and programmatically close the suggestion list while preserving the input value. This avoids replacing the library's internal keydown handler.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Escape while editing a city will dismiss the autocomplete suggestions without losing the user's typed input, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order) by ensuring keyboard dismissal works predictably.
functional_risks: If the library uses onkeydown property instead of addEventListener, the custom listener may not intercept in time (mitigated by preventDefault)
The close() method may not exist on the instance (guarded with typeof check)
verification_requirements: ArrowDown and Enter still select suggestions
Form submission saves the typed city
